articles.headline: Roldan: USMNT can't be 'too honest' against 'savvy' Paraguay
articles.description: After their last meeting with Paraguay ended in a near-brawl, the USMNT is steeling itself for another fiery match in Friday's World Cup opener.

images.caption: Tempers flared at the end of the USMNT's friendly with Paraguay last November.

articles.headline: Somali referee for World Cup denied entry into United States
articles.description: Somali referee Omar Artan has been denied entry into the United States after getting selected to officiate in the World Cup.

articles.headline: Texas joins N.Y., N.J., California in probes over FIFA World Cup ticket practices
articles.description: The Texas Attorney General's Office said it has opened an investigation into FIFA's World Cup ticket sale practices following complaints alleging fans were misled about seat locations for matches to be played in Dallas and Houston.

images.name: AT&T Stadium [1296x729]
images.caption: England and Croatia will kick off their World Cup campaigns at AT&T Stadium in Texas.
images.credit: William Purnell/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images

images.name: at&t stadium [1296x729]
images.caption: General view outside the stadium, home of the Dallas Cowboys and host venue for the FIFA World Cup 2026,  ahead of the CONCACAF Gold Cup Group D match between United States and Haiti at AT&T Stadium on June 22, 2025 in Arlington, Texas.

images.name: U.S. Soccer CEO's message to fans concerned by ticket prices
images.caption: U.S. Soccer Federation CEO JT Batson says his message to fans is "there are all sorts of ways" to feel a part of the World Cup, amid concern over ticket prices.
